summary: @servicetitan/form-state 41.3.7 preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundle
details: The package's preinstall script (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases for the detected platform/arch, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle with shuffled string-array obfuscation (WV8StW rotator, hex-mangled identifiers such as MmgoCP and etDiOOB) and is only reachable through this preinstall dropper. The package advertises itself as a React form-state helper under the @servicetitan scope; that stated purpose does not require a second language runtime or an opaque bundle at install time. On npm install the fetched Bun binary automatically executes the obfuscated payload on the installer's host, granting arbitrary install-time code execution. The dist/ tree containing the advertised form-state code is unrelated to the preinstall payload, consistent with a hijacked-scope or compromised-maintainer publish of a version that combines a legitimate-looking library with an out-of-scope alternate-runtime dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
